title: Third Bridge Launches Expert Commentary, Adding Peer Review to Interview Takeaways
summary: Third Bridge launched Expert Commentary, a content-library enhancement that adds peer-reviewed perspectives from other experts to the key takeaways of its analyst-led interviews, so clients can compare contrasting opinions within a single transcript. All submissions are AI-reviewed for material non-public information and then verified by Third Bridge's sector analysts. Clients can see contributing experts' names and employment histories and request further consultations. Head of R&D Rudy deHemptinne said the firm is "moving beyond the traditional 1:1 interview model."
whyItMatters: Layering multiple expert viewpoints onto one transcript is a content-quality response to the commoditization of raw transcripts — and a way to raise the value of a library that is increasingly consumed through AI tools.
